lastCompletedStory.title: Keep derived fix-story titles out of the PR-body setup checklist

nextStoryContext: CAM-478 (US-003) fixed renderSetupChecklist (src/release/pr-body.ts) so a review-generated fix story's finding-derived title (US-002, deriveFixStoryTitle) can no longer contaminate the PR-body Setup checklist cue haystack. Fix stories minted by buildFixStories (src/supervisor/review.ts) always get id `US-R<round>-<nnn>` (e.g. US-R1-001), a shape no human-authored story id (US-XXX) ever matches. Added a module-level `FIX_STORY_ID_PATTERN = /^US-R\d+-/` in pr-body.ts and filtered prd.userStories on that pattern (excluding matches) before mapping to titles that feed the haystack; prd.description and prd.notes are untouched, and human-authored story titles (including ones that legitimately carry a cue word, e.g. 'Register the payment webhook token') still reach the haystack unfiltered, so genuine cues keep firing. Two tests added to test/release/pr-body.test.ts, appended at the end of the 'composePrBody Setup checklist' describe block: 'derived fix-story title does not contaminate the setup checklist' (builds an identical PRD with vs without an extra US-R1-001 story whose title contains the literal word 'token', asserts the '## Setup checklist' section slice is byte-identical between the two -- red on unmodified pr-body.ts, recorded in patterns.md per AC3) and 'a genuine setup cue in a human-authored story title still fires' (US-001-shaped id with a cue word in the title still renders the table, guarding against an overbroad fix that filters ALL story titles rather than just fix-story-shaped ids). All 28 tests in test/release/pr-body.test.ts pass (26 pre-existing + 2 new); full bun run check:all spine green, no file-size ceiling raise needed (pr-body.ts and pr-body.test.ts both stayed under budget). This closes out CAM-478 (US-001/US-002/US-003 all done); PRD should now be complete pending review.
